question: Where in Assam was the Charaichung Festival held in December 2025 to support the revival of Asia’s oldest bird sanctuary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Majuli.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Charaichung Festival 2025 was held in Majuli, focusing on reviving the historic Royal Bird Sanctuary established in 1633.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Majuli, the world’s largest river island, hosted the second edition of the Charaichung Festival.**
 
• **The event aimed to revive the Charaichung (Royal Bird) Sanctuary, one of Asia’s oldest protected sites.**
 
• **Majuli is a crucial habitat for more than 150 bird species, including migratory birds.**
 
• **The festival highlighted conservation efforts and strengthened Majuli’s eco-tourism potential.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Majuli**__

 __
 
• Located on the Brahmaputra River in Assam.
 
• Recognised for rich biodiversity, cultural heritage, and unique wetland ecosystems.
 
 
 
• **Charaichung (Royal Bird) Sanctuary**__
 __
 
• Established in 1633 by Ahom king Swargadeu Pratap Singha.
 
• Faces severe degradation but is undergoing community-backed restoration.
 
 
 
• **Charaichung Festival**__
 __
 
• Held from December 7–10, 2025.
 
• Included conservation exhibitions and drew interest from international tourists.
 
 
 
• **Key Personalities**__
 
 
• **Durgeswar Saikia** – Highlighted the sanctuary’s deterioration and revival efforts.
 
• **Bhaskar Jyoti Kutum** – Stressed the need for greater government support to preserve bird habitats.
